info.name: Pacino's Enterprise - Complete Inventory Management API Collection
info.description:
100% Tested & Complete Postman Collection for all Inventory & Stock Management APIs in the Alipacino Backend.

Key Modules Covered:
0. Authentication (Auto-saves Bearer Token)
1. Inventory Categories (CRUD)
2. Suppliers Management (CRUD)
3. Inventory Items & Stock (CRUD, Raw/Prepared Types, Yield/Packs Ratios, Image Upload, CSV Export, Branch Distribution, Dashboard KPIs & Turnover Analytics)
4. Audited Inventory Transactions (Purchase with Supplier, Restock, Sale, Waste, Adjustments +/- with Auto Stock Update)
5. Stock Conversions (Live Yield Calculator, Batch Convert Packs, Manual Conversions, Reversible Audits)
6. Recipes & Bill of Materials (BOM) (CRUD, Ingredient Association for Order Consumption)

item.name: 0. Authentication
item.description: Get access token to authenticate all inventory requests.

request.description: Logs in as HQ Administrator and automatically stores the Bearer token in collectionVariables.
Verify current authenticated session and user permissions.

item.name: 1. Inventory Categories
item.description: Classification of inventory items (e.g. Meat & Poultry, Dairy, Produce, Packaging).

request.description: Returns paginated categories list with branch and items count.
Creates a new category for a branch and auto-sets inventory_category_id.
Returns category with its associated branch and items.
Updates an existing category.
Safely deletes category. Returns 422 if category contains existing items.

item.name: 2. Suppliers Management
item.description: Manage vendors and suppliers providing raw materials and goods.

query.description: Sort by: id, name, email, phone, created_at

request.description: Lists suppliers with their branch details.
Creates a new supplier and auto-captures supplier_id.

body.raw:
{
    "branch_id": 1,
    "name": "Prime Wholesale Meats Ltd",
    "phone": "+44 20 7946 0958",
    "email": "orders@primemeats.example.com",
    "address": "Unit 4, Smithfield Wholesale Market, London"
}

request.description: Returns detailed supplier info.
Updates supplier contact details.
Deletes supplier. Returns 204 No Content on success.

item.name: 3. Inventory Items & Stock
item.description: Raw materials and prepared stock items, yield ratios, CSV export, analytics, and branch distribution.

request.description: Returns paginated inventory items with branch, category, and madeFromItem relationship.

item.name: Create Raw Material Item (e.g. Minced Beef)

request.description: Creates raw material item and auto-saves inventory_item_id.

body.raw:
{
    "branch_id": 1,
    "category_id": 1,
    "type": "raw_material",
    "name": "Minced Beef 80/20",
    "sku": "RM-BEEF-001",
    "quantity": 100,
    "minimum_stock": 15,
    "unit": "kg",
    "description": "Fresh premium minced beef 80/20 blend",
    "purchase_price": 5.5,
    "selling_price": null
}

item.name: Create Prepared Item with Conversion Ratio (e.g. Burger Patties)

request.description: Creates prepared item with conversion configuration (made_from_item_id, pack_size, yield_qty) so /calculate and /convert work immediately.

body.raw:
{
    "branch_id": 1,
    "category_id": 1,
    "type": "prepared",
    "name": "Burger Patties (150g)",
    "sku": "PR-PATTY-150G",
    "quantity": 0,
    "minimum_stock": 20,
    "unit": "pcs",
    "description": "Formed beef patties prepared from raw minced beef",
    "purchase_price": 0.85,
    "selling_price": 2.5,
    "made_from_item_id": 1,
    "pack_size": 1.5,
    "pack_unit": "kg",
    "yield_qty": 10,
    "yield_unit": "pcs"
}

request.description: Creates item with photo attachment via multipart/form-data.
Returns item details including category, branch, madeFromItem and transaction supplier history.

item.name: Update Inventory Item (Auto-logs Adjustment if qty changes)

request.description: Updates item attributes. If quantity changes, controller automatically logs an adjustment transaction to keep audit trails accurate.
Returns total items, low stock alerts, out of stock count, total branches, and total stock valuation with 7-day movement percentage.
Calculates inventory turnover ratio, daily consumption value, top-selling product from stock, and damaged/wasted items.
Streams a downloadable CSV file (inventory-items.csv) containing all stock information.
Safely moves stock from the current branch to branch #2. Auto-creates item in target branch if not exists, and logs transfer_out and transfer_in audit records.
Deletes item if no dependent recipes, transactions or conversions exist (otherwise returns clear 422 blocker message).

item.name: 4. Inventory Transactions (Stock Movement & Auditing)
item.description: Fully audited stock movements. Increases/decreases stock atomically with DB row lock.

query.description: purchase, sale, waste, adjustment, restock, transfer_in, transfer_out, conversion_in, conversion_out

request.description: Returns paginated audit log of stock movements with creator and supplier details.
Records stock purchase, links vendor supplier_id, increases item quantity, and updates item status.
Increases stock under restock transaction type.
Deducts stock for sales. Rejects with 422 if stock is insufficient.
Deducts stock for waste/spoilage and records audit log.
Increases stock on manual count adjustment.
Decreases stock on manual count adjustment.
Returns transaction details with branch, creator, and supplier info.
Quantity and type are immutable to preserve audit integrity; only notes can be updated.
Deletes transaction and cleanly reverses its effect on stock inside a locked DB transaction.

item.name: 5. Stock Conversions (Raw -> Prepared)
item.description: Transform raw materials into prepared food items (e.g. Minced Beef -> Burger Patties) with live yield preview and batch conversion.

request.description: Lists conversion logs with source/target items, branch and user info.
Read-only simulation. Calculates how many prepared items will be produced from raw material quantity without altering stock.

item.name: 2. Convert Whole Packs into Prepared Item (/convert)

request.description: Converts whole packs using the item configuration. Deducts raw material, adds prepared item stock, and creates conversion_out & conversion_in audit transactions.
Manually transfers quantity from source raw item to target prepared item.
Returns conversion details.
Reconciles stock delta difference between old and new quantity safely.
Reverses source and target item stocks and deletes the conversion log.

item.name: 6. Recipes & Bill of Materials (BOM)
item.description: Link menu items to inventory ingredients so POS & online orders automatically deduct raw materials.

request.description: Lists recipes with menuItem, branch, and ingredients.inventoryItem.
Creates recipe linked to a menu item with ingredient lines.
Returns recipe with menuItem and nested ingredients.
Updates recipe header and replaces ingredient list.
Adds or updates a single ingredient on the recipe.
Removes single ingredient line from recipe.
Deletes recipe and all its ingredients.
